The Alternative Investment & Manager Selection (AIMS) team at Goldman Sachs will look to make LP anchor

DST Opportunities II Access — note: dots due end of next week
DST provides clients exposure to DST Global VI as well as to co-investment opportunities alongside DST
Global VI. Founded by Yuri Milner in 2009, DST Global is raising its sixth fund to pursue non-controlling
investments in late-stage private companies in the global Internet industry with valuations of at least $500
million. By leveraging its global network, DST typically targets companies with the following investment
charactenstics: (i) category leaders; (ii) strong CEO / management teams; (iii) high secular growth; and (iv) a
clear path to potential profitability. DST has invested in companies such as Facebook, Alibaba Group, JD.com
Spotify, Didi, Airbnb, Meituan, Kuaishou, Auto1, etc.

Viola Growth III Access -- note: docs due end of the month
Founded in 1999, Viola Group is an Israel-based investment firm that currently manages nearly $3 billion in
AUM across five separately-managed strategies, including Viola Growth. Established in 2008, Viola Growth is
currently raising Fund III to pursue expansion phase investments in innovative global technology companies
that are based in Israel or have strong connections to Israel. The Fund will primarily target companies with
revenues over $10 million in the fields of cloud analytics, marketing, fintech, machine leaming and
cybersecurity.

Petershill Private Equity Seeding
The Alternative Investment & Manager Selection (AIMS) team at Goldman Sachs will look to make LP anchor
investments in next generation private equity managers. In addition to traditional LP retums, the strategy will
pursue revenue sharing opportunities and preferred strategic rights as part of its total return strategy. Aims to
invest in 6-8 managers and seeks to build a diverse portfolio across managers, geographies and strategies.
